english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is not practical or workable.
Choose this when the idea is impractical or unrealistic rather than simply technically impossible.

examples.english: Making a living on luck alone is too impractical.
examples.traditional: 淨係靠運氣搵食，呢個諗法太唔實際喇。

examples.english: It is unfeasible for one person to visit all of Hong Kong in one day.
examples.traditional: 一個人想喺一日內行勻全香港，實在唔實際。
